## Chemical interpretation

All inputs are simulated teaching data. The inlet mean is 19.5 mg/L and outlet mean 12.5 mg/L, each from four independently collected samples. The 7.0 mg/L difference is descriptive for the supplied sampling design; it does not establish causation or a population-wide temporal mean. A 0.250 L portion at 20.0 mg/L contains 5.00 mg chloride.

```{r plots}
for (name in names(plots)) print(plots[[name]])
```

## Transfer and limits

The transfer result is 3.00 mg/L. A location-wide mean requires a sampling design; an uncertainty needs the relevant measurement and sampling contributions.

The complete executable solution is in `R/analyse-sample-answer.R`. The student lesson
and data dictionary specify the measurand, input units and row meanings. A
conditional teaching result is not full method validation.
